notes: Distinctive surname plus specialty pinned this down immediately. Two official sources agree: (1) apollohospitals.com's own doctor profile at /doctors/internal-medicine-physician/hyderabad/dr-jaganmani-sreekanth (name + Internal Medicine + Hyderabad), and (2) his Apollo247 doctor page (Dr. Sreekanth Jaganmani, General Physician/Internal Medicine Specialist, Hyderabad), which is the platform explicitly treated as official in the brief. The exact unit is confirmed by the AskApollo page whose title reads 'Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills', matching the address given for this row, and the stated 25+ years of experience matches the profile's career timeline (Apollo Hyderabad consultant since 1998). Caveat for a human: apollohospitals.com, askapollo.com and apollo247.com are all Apollo-group properties, so they are separate published sources but not wholly independent organisations. No professional email and no doctor-specific published phone line exists anywhere indexed - only aggregator/JustDial call-tracking numbers and the Apollo central helpline, both of which the brief rules out, so both contact fields were left blank. No LinkedIn, ORCID, Google Scholar, ResearchGate or healinindia.gov.in profile found. Minor discrepancy noted, nothing recorded from it: aggregator sites variously state 25 and 31 years of experience; only the '25+' figure consistent with the Apollo profile timeline was recorded. Also note that one aggregator (newgendoctors.com) mislabels him an ophthalmologist - that stems from his Diploma in Ophthalmology; the Apollo pages state Internal Medicine, which is what was recorded.
